question: Should I support this budget or oppose it?
note: The eval runner saved only the final answer, so no steps are shown. Statement kinds weren't saved and are shown as "fact"; every citation was checked again by code when this file was made. The start time is worked out from the report's end time and each case's duration.

event.text: I cannot advise you on whether to support or oppose the budget. On one hand, focusing the budget on basic services and keeping up infrastructure helps keep regional services steady [1, 2]. This focus also supports plans to create or preserve 3,500 affordable homes by 2029 [3]. On the other hand, closing the Region's $87.6 million annual infrastructure gap could raise regional costs for property owners [4, 1]. Your regional property tax may change, building on an average increase of $142 in 2026 [5].

statements.text: Protecting infrastructure keeps services steady, but funding it could raise regional costs for property owners.
